x: Whilst all this was going on, the field events people were performing and it is something to be proud of to have the first three in the weight put beating 45 feet. J. Jones was first with 46ft. 3½ins., a championship best, with T.

As we had no one for the mile, George again turned out and although only finishing 6th, scored another point. In the field events J. Jones was in great form and broke the ground record for the shot put with 47ft. 1in.
As the second half of the race proceeded P.Flavel (Oxford City) and J. Jones (Windsor, S & E) drew away and dead-heated in 50:03 with Bill following them in 26 seconds later.

Senior: D.T: 3.J.Jones 29.50. In the London Borough Championships Heats Veronica St.Ange won the javelin with 41.52, Jessica Palma was 2nd in the 200m with 28.0 and Rosemary Honeychurch won the 1500m with 4:46.2, while Yvette Edwards ran a 13.1 100m.
